posts.author_bio: ⚡The model sees what Vegas doesn't. AI-powered picks, player props & matchup analytics across NBA · NFL · MLB · NHL.⚡
posts.post_caption:
“What’s your model actually based on?”

It’s the fair question to ask anyone selling predictions, and most won’t answer it. So here’s ours.

WHAT GOES IN

→ Team form built from past results, scoring and possessions
→ Schedule context: rest days, back-to-backs, playoff status
→ Pregame odds where we have them — and explicitly flagged where we don’t, because coverage has real gaps and pretending otherwise is how models learn the wrong thing
→ Sport-specific inputs: prior starting pitcher performance for MLB, goaltending for NHL

WHAT STAYS PRIVATE

The formulas, the weights, the tuning. That’s the actual work, and publishing it would just mean someone else runs it.

WHY POST THIS AT ALL

Because “trust the algorithm” isn’t an argument. If you can’t tell whether a model is reading real inputs or vibes, you have no way to judge its output — and neither do we. Knowing what goes in is how you decide what a prediction is worth.

Two things we’d rather say than not:

This is a description of what the code does. It is not a verified audit of the exact data behind any deployed model.

Probabilities are estimates. No model guarantees wins.

Full methodology at hyperleez.us/methodology
